blocks.text: We have moved into a time of swift events and sudden changes concerning nature and society. – Signs all around us! Turmoil and chaos have taken over the Middle East. Several countries are in riots and rebellion against the present regimes. As we move closer to the next seven year cycle, which starts March 11, 2011, so many events have already taken place. These are strategic happenings making way for the coming peace agreement in the Middle East. Let’s take a look at other signs. The World Bank has reported global food prices have risen almost 30% over the last 12 months. This is a great concern and has created political instability in many parts of the world coupled along with overall inflation. The weather has been the strangest already this year with cold and heavy snows, floods and droughts, fires, earthquakes as well as volcanic activity. Truly the earth is trembling! As Jesus said, these events would be near His return. – A strange event happened with the report from the Arctic Circle in Greenland – the sun came back over the horizon two days early! Could this be connected to the recent earthquakes that caused the earth to slow its rotation by a few milliseconds? Brother Frisby once spoke about an axis change coming at the end of the age. (Read Isa. 24:20, Amos 8:9, Ps. 82:5) All of this is happening along with some of the largest solar flares that were noted within the last few days. We are moving closer to the height of the solar cycle, which is bringing a catastrophic climate change. (Luke 21: 25-28) Also read verses 35 and 36.

I have posted many letters concerning the economy. Real estate is still in a downward move especially commercial. Shopping centers are losing their tenants leaving vacant stores. Major bankruptcy is effecting many retail companies. Even though interest rates are low the problem is a huge debt load that they’ve been carrying. Banks are repossessing more houses and property and will soon be under more stress bringing more bank failures. Every day somewhere banks are failing. A global collapse of all economies appears to be on the horizon. A new money system will come. The IMF (International Money Fund) along with Europe, Asia, China and the Arab nations are calling for a gold backed currency. As we see it coming it will bring the new systems as well as the final events just before the return of the Lord Jesus. Here are some words that Brother Frisby spoke. And now a quote from Neal Frisby.

“Jesus will anoint and guide you more than ever! By His light He will reveal the path that is before us! We can expect more understanding of His plans and more revelation of the future so as to prepare for the translation!” – “According to II Peter 1:19, ‘we shall have a more sure Word of prophecy, wherein all should take heed! It will be like light shining in a dark place as the day dawn, and the Day Star (of prophecy) arise in your hearts’!” – “We will not be left in darkness, but we will absolutely know the times and seasons of His coming! He has definitely shown us things to come for we will not be sleeping, but we will be alert concerning the latter times!” – “We are in store for many exciting and wonderful promises for He will personally enlighten us!” – Rev. 19:10 confirms all of this to us! “For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy!” – “So we see for a certainty we will know what to expect in preparing for His arrival!” “He shall not hide that which we are to know, but will portray it openly unto us!” “We have seen inklings and foreshadows of His mighty power, but in the final gathering of the elect we will feel the fullness of His spirit as a tremendous light working the miraculous among us! Behold, I will give My people strength! Yea, the Lord Jesus will bless His people with peace and understanding! He will cast a light before them and will reveal the future and the way! He will pour the full armour of the anointing upon them! What a time we live in! Let us expect the extraordinary in the time ahead!”

It appears with the activity in the Middle East that all of the Scriptures listed in this letter are truly coming to pass right before our eyes. We are the last generation and blessed with a wonderful and prophetic message written by Neal Frisby. I have two Special Writings that I know you will enjoy, “The Electronic Age” and “God’s Original Time.” As well as a vital DVD called “Unaware! (Pompeii)”. (See offer below.) Truly the earth has been unaware of the activities that have been taking place. Now is the time to publish this valuable message for soon time is truly running out. The greatest blessings will be for those who sound the alarm and warn people of the soon return of the Lord Jesus. I thank each and every one of you for your continued prayers and support of Brother Frisby’s blessed ministry. Your Brother in Christ,
